_comment: GATED mutation lane (Core-Laws-and-Precedents.md). Pinned to the highest-stakes pure modules — prompt assembly + credential resolution — where a surviving mutant means a test asserts presence-of-behavior without asserting correctness (the `isVllmBackend`-lying-gate class neo founded this on). Unlike the exploratory stryker.config.json (break:null), this FAILS the build below `thresholds.break` — a ratchet-down regression guard. NOT in `pnpm check` (mutation runs are minutes; the check budget is structural-fast) — run on demand via `pnpm test:mutation:gate` + from CI. RUNNABLE (PD-114): both target files + their tests exist; `break` stays null until calibrated from a measured run.
_plugins_comment: Explicit plugin paths — pnpm's strict layout breaks Stryker auto-discovery.
_mutate_comment: EXACTLY the highest-stakes files — no globs. Keep tight: break is calibrated to this set's measured score. (PD-114 dropped the phantom domain/chat/routing.ts — prompt assembly is assembly/assemble.ts.)
_ignore_comment: Prune the sandbox copy — same shape as the base config. .cache/** (8.8G vLLM venv; its lib64 symlink crashes copyfile EISDIR) and .models/** (25G HF weights) MUST be excluded or the sandbox copy explodes. data/** + *.db* (the dev database) are pruned too — ignorePatterns is ACTIVE now that the sandbox patch makes a NORMAL sandbox work (it was a no-op under the old --inPlace).
_coverage_comment: coverageAnalysis NOT set — the vitest-runner ignores it and always uses perTest.
_concurrency_comment: 24-core / 125GB box; default is n-1 (=23). 16 → ~8 checker + ~8 runner processes with headroom. Bump toward 20 for a dedicated run.
_thresholds_comment: break is the GATE — Stryker exits non-zero when the AGGREGATE score across the pinned files drops below it. RUNNABLE as of 2026-07-12 (V4): the dry-run blocker is fixed — vitest.stryker.config.ts now excludes the tokens generated-file freshness meta-test (tests/ui/tokens/**), which failed the initial run because Stryker's disableTypeChecks preprocessor injects a `// @ts-nocheck` header the freshness regen doesn't produce. TO CALIBRATE: run ONE full uninterrupted `pnpm test:mutation:gate` (it needs > the 10-min single-command budget: ~2.1G first-run rsync + dry-run + the mutant matrix over 2 files), read the aggregate mutation score, set break ~6pts under it, then ratchet UP as suites gain real assertions (neo's history: aggregate climbed 55.41%→66.31% over a hardening pass; break sat at 60). Stays null until that measured run lands — a null break never fails, and guessing a break without the measured baseline would falsely fail or vacuously pass. The gate LANDS in the verify --full tier (quality:mutation-gate) either way.
